search_text: published ZDI-19-927 ZDI-CAN-8879 (0Day) Jenkins Fortify on Demand Uploader Cleartext Storage of Credentials Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2019-10-30 3.3 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N ['Jenkins'] ['Fortify on Demand Uploader'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Jenkins Fortify On Demand Uploader. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Fortify On Demand Uploader plugin. The issue results from storing credentials in plaintext. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the build process.
